Native Adventure inventory source reconstruction

Source images come from data/runtime/native-pe-images.json:
Steam PE:6a70a6d9:02711000, classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000.
All coordinates below are RVAs in the Steam image. The paired classic
coordinates and every literal/control edge are preserved in the TSV/ASM files.
This is offline source extraction and reconstructed production logic. Nothing
in this directory executes the game or evaluates translation output.

Renderer: 8819f0..883f14, embedded selector table 883f14..883f40.
The unwind extent includes the selector data; that data is decoded separately,
not treated as x64 instructions. Titles dispatch on option-list context +4:
  0: Your inventory
  1: What do you want to drop?
  2: What do you want to wear?
  3: What do you want to remove?
  4: What do you want to place?
  5: What do you want to eat or drink?
  6: With what do you want to interact?
  7: Where do you put <complete item designation, article mode 1>?
  8: What will you do with <complete item designation, article mode 1>?
  9: What will you do with <complete item designation, article mode 1>?
 10: What do you want to throw?
 Other selector values bypass title construction. Done is constructed inline.
 Inventory mode also generates Burden: <weight>/<capacity> followed by the
 native weight glyph; values below one use <1. Title modes 7, 8 and 9 draw
 prefix, item designation and question mark separately.

Each visible choice is a native three-cell-high record (8833d2..8833ee divides
the available height by three), with a nesting depth from option +8:
  background and optional item graphic: entire three-cell-high record;
  key:     x = content_left + depth + 7, y = record_top + 1, call c394b0;
  caption: x = content_left + depth + 9, y = record_top + 1;
  location:x = content_left + depth + 7, y = record_top + 2.
The key and caption use native color 01010007; location uses 01010003.
Thus equal color does not merge the key with the caption. The location has its
own origin, independent of the two-cell key-to-caption spacing.

for each visible option:
  graphic = option.virtual[+c8](current_tick)
  draw three rows of native picture/background skin
  draw independent keyboard key
  caption = option.virtual[context in {8,9} ? +10 : +8](string)
  remaining = content_right - depth - content_left
  limit = remaining - (context == 0 ? 34 : 13)
  if caption.length >= limit - 1:
    if limit >= 0: resize caption to limit
    if limit > 3: overwrite caption[limit-3..limit-1] with "..."
  draw caption
  inventory_record = option.virtual[+d8]()
  if inventory_record != null:
    location = item_location(player_unit, inventory_record)
    location_limit = remaining - 32
    if location.length >= location_limit - 1:
      if location_limit >= 0: resize location to location_limit
      if location_limit > 3: overwrite final three characters with "..."
    draw independent location line
  flags = option.virtual[+f8]()
  for bit in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64}:
    if flags & bit: draw corresponding right-hand action graphic
  advance record top by 3
No branch inserts a literal Open or On state in these item-selection rows.

The shortened native string cannot prove its full item or location grammar.
The native item caption virtual 894180 delegates to complete-item-designation
c65450 with article mode -1 and appends its entire result. This designation
function spans two adjacent unwind ranges c65450..c6571d..c65f0a. Both ranges
are preserved. Artifact identity and copy suffix, material/quantity, quality,
wear, improvements and named-item branches belong to the existing complete
item-title owner graph in item-description-sources.tsv and
item-info-title-sources.tsv; they are not inferred from screenshot words.

Location producer: 1393900..13946f4, table 13946f4..1394724.
The record is item* at +0, signed int16 role +8, signed int16 body part +a,
Pet seed +c, and wound/nocked-in item ID +10. Roles outside 0..11 produce an
empty location. Body-part names are the complete dynamic RAW name, not words
chosen from English spelling. Native first-letter capitalization is 52d650.
Known body parts select singular/plural NAME vectors according to their native
number. Absent names or invalid body parts produce body part/body parts.

switch role:
 0 Hauled:
   if native mouth/body eligibility: "In Mouth"
   else if designated hidden/carrying-item relationship: "Hidden"
   else: "Hauled"
 1 Weapon:
   if item's virtual +380 and player's grasp-state predicate require it:
     "Multigrasp"
   else: capitalized body-part helper 13345d0(unit,bp,0,mode=2)
 2 Worn:
   capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
 3 Piercing:
   "In " + capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
 4 Flask:
   find another inventory record of role Worn(2) or WrappedAround(5) with
   the same body-part ID;
   if its item exists: capitalized complete item designation
   else: capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
 5 WrappedAround:
   "Wrapped around " + capitalized body-part helper (mode=2)
 6 StuckIn:
   "Stuck in " + capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
 7 InMouth:
   capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
 8 Pet:
   deterministic seed-based choice among "On head", "Left shoulder",
   "Right shoulder"; head choice requires an eligible HEAD body part,
   otherwise repeat the choice loop
 9 SewnInto:
   "Sewn into " + capitalized body-part helper (mode=2)
10 Strapped:
   "Strapped to " + capitalized complete singular/plural body-part name
11 Nocked:
   "Nocked"
   if record +10 resolves an item:
     append " in " + capitalized complete item designation

The shared body-part helper is preserved in full as 13345d0..1334819.
Its index/count/name-mode branches can produce numbered body-part names,
singular or plural names, and body part/body parts fallback. Inventory callers
use count=0, name-mode=2, so native body-part multiplicity owns plural choice.

Coin title owner: ca0d00..ca0d55; actual item_coinst title virtual is +5e8.
If item.coin_batch(+e8) != -1, call 5be970(batch,string), then tail-call
ca5bb0(item,string,noun_mode). Batch fields align with df.coinbatch.xml:
  +0 year, +c entity/civilization ID, +10 ruler/historical-figure ID.

coin_identity(batch):
  if batch.entity == -1: return
  entity = lookup civilization by ID
  append format_native_name(entity.name at +20) + " "
  if entity RAW contains the native dated-currency flag:
    if batch.year != -1: append decimal(batch.year) + " "
  else if batch.ruler != -1:
    figure = lookup historical figure by ID
    if figure exists: append format_native_name(figure.name at +38) + " "

coin_material_noun(item):
  read item type, subtype, material type/index, quantity and maker race from
  bound native getters, then call a82c10 with actual item type 74 (COIN).
  noun mode 1 fixes quantity=1; mode 2 fixes quantity=-1; ordinary mode obtains
  the actual stack quantity. These leaves and all material/name/noun branches
  are the existing complete item-description/title source graph.

Consequently, a name-like coin prefix is native civilization/ruler data.
The source graph offers no Open/On UI state for a coin row. A visible generic
translation such as 开启 cannot establish a native state; full row ownership
must preserve the minted identity as part of the complete item designation.

Native inline shortening blocks and inserted-call register contract:
  name inventory: 8836aa..8836c0, alternate append call 8836cc;
  name selection: 883711..883727, alternate append call 883733;
  location:       883846..88385c, alternate append call 883868.
  Nonvolatile RBX, RDI, RSI, R12, R13, R14 and R15 remain live. The following
  comparisons and dot writers reload all necessary volatile registers; no
  pre-block RCX/RDX/R8/R9/R10/R11 value or flags survive as an input. At every
  continuation the next comparison replaces flags. Native string object
  addresses are RBP-78 for name and RBP-30 for location. Branch destinations
  are retained in native-branches.tsv, including jumps into resize paths.

Native option source frame and formatter ownership (both PE editions):
  renderer pushes eight nonvolatile registers; rbp = pushed_rsp - 8;
  rsp = rbp - 0x100 after sub rsp,0x108. Name source NativeString is rbp-0x78.
  list = *(source_object - 0x40), saved at rsp+0x48.
  index = *(uint64_t*)(source_object - 0x10), saved at rsp+0x78.
  Require index < ((list.options_end at +0x20)-(list.options_begin at +0x18))/8.
  option = list.options_begin[index]; mode = *(int32_t*)(list+4).
  provider = option.vtable[(mode==8 || mode==9) ? 0x10 : 0x08].
  Name draw return RVA: Steam 883790; Classic 881010.
  This recovers the actual RTTI virtual formatter without source-word guessing.
  The object address must be the passed NativeString, not its .data() pointer.
  Saved index Steam 883446 / Classic 880cc6; virtual name calls Steam
  88363c(+8),883641(+10), Classic 880ebc(+8),880ec1(+10).
  Full inventory item designation provider: 894180 / 891a00.
  Pure view contaminant provider: 8392a0 / 836b20.
  Eat unit contaminant provider: 839850 / 8370d0.
  Eat item contaminant provider: 839ca0 / 837520.
  Other actual owner/provider pairs are retained in native-option-owners.tsv;
  the complete action production graph remains adventure-action-menu/.

Shortcut display production:
  key = visible_index + 0x52 -> c394b0 (Classic c364f0).
  Preserve old text colors; set native green 01010002; resolve binding by
  interface_key enum through 8ecb30 (Classic 8ea360); draw returned string;
  restore all saved native color fields.
  Actual key draw call/return: Steam c3954a/c3954f, Classic c3658a/c3658f.
  Binding tree at 2390658 (Classic 238a548) uses interface enum as key.
  Bound nonempty vector: read first binding and copy its string at +0x20.
  This native branch has no alphabetic, case, length or single-character gate.
  Numeric, symbol, modifier combinations and named keys therefore follow
  configured binding display text. Default custom bindings use a-z and A-Z.
  Missing key node or empty binding: diagnostic Missing binding displayed:
  plus the enum label, followed by output NativeString size1 and byte '?'.
  Steam fallback store 8ecdf0, Classic 8ea620. The original caption anchor is
  key_x+2 regardless of key text width; later caption overwrites the right
  part of a long displayed binding. Full key source is its draw source.

Picture-absent option row:
  icon = option.virtual(+0xc8). If zero, skip adad70 picture draw.
  Native standard rectangle is still drawn over every column and all three
  rows: Steam 88351c(left),883529(right),883536(interior). The source row
  changes top/middle/bottom tiles; the key and complete caption retain their
  ordinary fixed anchors, and an inventory record still supplies line2 if
  virtual(+0xd8) returns nonzero. No icon does not mean no text/button.
  view/eat unit/eat item contaminant and environment_ingest_material getters
  are constant zero (66e90 / Classic66e20). Their +d8 getter is also zero.
  Mode5 blood icon getter89ad30/8985b0, item-from-container ingestion icon
  7e1630/7deeb0 are nonzero-capable. Mode7 pack89b8b0/899130, building
  89aed0/898750, item7e1630/7deeb0 are nonzero-capable. All +d8 remain zero.

Contaminant captions and inventory grammar boundary:
  view_contaminant = deposit(unit.contaminant) + ' (' + native bodypart + ')'.
  eat_unit_contaminant = (state==1 ? 'Drink ' : 'Eat ') + deposit +
                        ' (' + native bodypart + ')'.
  eat_item_contaminant = (state==1 ? 'Drink ' : 'Eat ') + deposit +
                        ' (' + complete item designation + ')'.
  Deposit source657f90/6559b0 and its entire finite quantity/material graph
  are retained in existing adventure-action-menu sources; native chooses
  dusting/coating/spatter/smear/covering/specks with of and bare alternatives.
  Existing health::contaminant::inventory only owns deposit(bodypart), plain
  deposit and finite deposit headings. Eat/Drink wrappers and item-parenthesis
  productions come from the action source graph and require their typed role.
  These providers write the same passed output NativeString as ordinary item
  designation. Output .data() alone does not identify the provider; the frame
  contract above preserves the virtual provider before the string is read.

Actual mode5 ingestion option loaders:
  inventory-options-builder 860040 / 85d8c0 uses ingestion vector at +0xc0,
  whose begin/end/capacity are +c0/c8/d0. All finite loader branches and four
  role/operation switch tables are retained in paired annotated assembly.
  Native constructed owners are eat_drink_itemst (860b93),
  environment_unit_suck_bloodst (86015d, source nearby unit conditions),
  environment_ingest_from_containerst (860f31, container item contents),
  environment_ingest_materialst (8611a0,8615d0,86179b,8618a7,861932;
  nearby map tiles, water and matter; typed material/state fields),
  eat_unit_contaminantst (861999, unit contaminant vector+6d0),
  eat_item_contaminantst (861b42, inventory item contaminant vector+98).
  Contained-item recursion861ec0/85f740 constructs eat_drink_itemst for
  nested items as well. The operation switch (9 entries) is retained separately
  from code at8625dc/85fe5c; embedded table bytes are not text-producing code.
  All owner caption functions are already in adventure-action-menu, including
  Suck unit possessive/material, Eat/Drink complete item from complete item(direction),
  Eat/Drink environmental material(direction), stagnant/salt qualifiers,
  unknown material fallbacks and native dynamic material-state/name branches.

Actual mode7 target option loaders:
  put_item action895f20/8937a0 sets modal mode7, selected item and copies
  option.target_vector(+0x20) to the selection vector. Getter4211a0/41ed60
  returns option+0x20. Target constructor899370/896bf0:
    player inventory -> place_in_it_container (899584), recursively enumerate
      nested containers899c10/897490 and skip selected item/containment cycles;
    eligible nearby/following pack animals -> place_on_pack_animal (899635,
      8996eb construction branches; 899898 insertion);
    completed eligible reachable buildings -> place_in_bld_container (89990f);
    reachable ground containers -> place_in_it_container (899b72).
  Native containment, capacity, reachability, unit RAW pack-animal flags,
  building subtype/build-stage and ground-item predicates are preserved as
  actual conditional edges in native-branches.tsv, not inferred from text.
  target caption owners are full action productions, including Put on unit,
  Put in item, Put in/on or Set on building, followed by native direction.
  The whole graph is already retained in adventure-action-menu; this inventory
  source adds actual constructor/loader and virtual getter evidence only.

Exact item-from-container field production (8387d0 / Classic836050):
  first = full_item_designation(option+0x28, r8b0, r9d-1),
          call Steam83883f / Classic8360bf;
  container = full_item_designation(option+0x20, r8b0, r9d-1),
              call Steam838855 / Classic8360d5;
  verb = option.item_at_28.virtual(+0x2b0) ? 'Drink ' : 'Eat ';
  output = verb + first + ' from ' + container;
  if origin coordinate at option+0x16 != -30000, append ' ('+direction+')'.
  This provider has no material-state or building-name virtual call. The
  actual environment material-state/stagnant/salt caption provider is
  Steam8389f0 / Classic836270, independently owned ingest_materialst.
